metadata.title: repo-nav
metadata.description: Interactive multi-repository navigator for the terminal — bilingual TUI (es/en), 8 themes, branch operations (switch/pull/push/merge/cherry-pick/compare/graph), favorites, aliases, lazy-loading, parallel discovery. PowerShell 7+ required.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.
